title: Member Care Specialist
description:
About Us:
For over 10 years, New Law Business Model (NLBM) has been on a mission to liberate lawyers from outdated, soul-crushing practice models. We provide the heart-centered framework-Life & Legacy Planning®-and the high-octane membership products required to build thriving, relational firms. With a community of 800+ Personal Family Lawyer® firms nationwide, we leverage elite AI and automation to amplify humanity, delivering the practical education, tools, and "done-for-you" systems lawyers need to reclaim their time and build a lasting legacy. We obsess over real-world outcomes, not just vibes, to ensure our members move from survival mode to true flourishing.
The Mission
This Member Care Specialist role is for a high-touch, relationship-oriented operator who can balance fierce empathy with extreme operational rigor. You'll love this role if you're energized by building genuine relationships, keeping things organized and moving, and being the steady, reliable presence that guides estate planning attorneys through their membership journey from day one.
You are equal parts member advocate, systems navigator, and clear communicator who takes pride in follow-through, consistency, and making sure no one falls through the cracks.
You should not apply if you struggle with high-volume CRM management, prefer to work in isolation, or dislike working cross-functionally across technical, product, and coaching teams.
Requirements
What You’ll Do
You’ll own the full lifecycle of assigned member accounts across our product portfolio, acting as their primary operational contact from onboarding through retention.
Pillar 1: Membership Support & Tiered Triage

• Serve as members' first point of contact for day-to-day support requests, answering emails and inquiries directly and resolving them within SLA response and resolution targets. Escalating to Coaching, Solutions Engineers, Product, or Web Developers when specialized follow-up is needed.

• Maintain an active account roster, proactively monitoring engagement, check-ins, and survey signals to identify at-risk members early and ensure lawyers are adopting our systems, executing retention interventions and coordinating tier upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and reactivations as needed.

• Troubleshoot access, setup, and implementation issues for members, coordinating with Operations, LBSCs, and Onboarding Specialists to keep the experience cohesive.

• Manage ticket pipelines for assigned accounts, ensuring accurate tagging, prioritization, and timely resolution within defined SLAs.

Pillar 2: Core Memberships Product Support

• Serve as a key point of contact for Core Membership members, supporting day-to-day needs and troubleshooting access and setup issues directly or in collaboration with Operations.

• Field and triage member support tickets to the appropriate teams (Coaching, Solutions Engineers, Product, or Web Developers), maintaining ticket hygiene and fast resolution times.

• Coordinate closely with Coaches and Onboarding Specialists to ensure a cohesive and aligned member experience across touchpoints.

• Facilitate administrative and resource support for Group Coaching calls, ensuring a seamless feedback loop between members, product managers, and coaches.

Pillar 3: Retention Intervention & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Identify at-risk members early through data and direct interactions, executing structured retention interventions or escalating concerns to Member Care leadership.

• Coordinate cross-brand transitions, including membership tier upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and reactivations with care, clarity, and precision.

• Surface operational trends, member friction points, and product suggestions to internal teams to drive continuous improvement in our overall learning experience.

What “Success” Looks Like

• Members on your roster feel genuinely supported,and that shows up in high active engagement and CSAT/NPS scores month-over-month.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. That sounds cool - what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it? Aperçu de l’entreprise
Chez Motorola Solutions , nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is the leading software developer and solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. The Emergency Call Handling solution team is one business sleeve of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness.
Présentation du Département
Motorola Solutions est le leader dans le développement de logiciels et la fourniture de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence. Ces logiciels permettent aux centres 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres de réception des appels de sécurité publique (Public Safety Answering Points) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. L'équipe de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence constitue une branche clé de la division Software Enterprise de Motorola Solutions , où des innovations sont développées pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, au dispatch des intervenants, et à la surveillance situationnelle.

Job Description
As a software developer, you will be joining a team developing a next generation 911 call handling solution that complies with industry standards and market demands, is capable of being deployed as a service or on-premises and meets high availability requirements our users have come to expect of 911 services. The team will utilize development talent across multiple design centers using Agile scrum methodology.
Responsibilities:
Analyzes, develops, designs, and maintains software for the organization’s products and systems.
Performs system integration of software and hardware to maintain throughput and program consistency.
Develops, validates, and tests: structures and user documentation.
Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or Computer Engineering.

• 4+ years of professional software development.

• Good knowledge of JAVA and its development ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with web application development (Angular, Javascript)

• Software Development: understanding of object-oriented coding and design, design patterns

• Excellent communication skills

• Experience developing cloud-based applications

• Experience developing REST-based APIs and implementing microservice principles and architectures

• Experience with modern Source control and DevOps tooling (including Git, Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines)

• Familiarity with the concepts involved in designing a high availability architecture

• Familiarity with observability and monitoring

• Familiarity with unit and automated testing

• Creativity and persistence when solving complex problems

• Enthusiasm for learning
